svg.title: yztr system architecture: UML component diagram
svg.desc: Layered architecture of yztr. Entry points (GitHub Action wrapper, CLI) call the Scan Orchestrator, which uses the analysis components (Diff Analyzer, Dependency Parser, Policy Engine, Report Generator and the three risk engines for vulnerabilities, licenses and typosquatting). The components share the Core Model; the risk engines reach OSV.dev and the package registries through the HTTP client and store metadata in an embedded H2 cache.
svg.text: UML component diagram · BIL 481 Project Assignment 2 · CodeShield
package orchestrator · runs the scan pipeline; the only component that knows all analysis components
«subsystem» Risk engines · independent of each other · each returns List<Finding>
